chat.settings.help.always_show_sidebar_o: Always keep the sidebar visible on desktop, rather than having it automatically hide.
chat.settings.help.api_key: If you are using the `--api-key` option when configuring the server, please set the API key.
chat.settings.help.ask_for_title_confirm: Before automatically changing the conversation title when editing the initial message, seek confirmation from the user.
chat.settings.help.auto_show_sidebar_on_: Automatically display the sidebar when a new chat is started. Disable this to keep the sidebar hidden until you click to show it.
chat.settings.help.backend_sampling: Enable server-side samplers. When enabled, supported samplers run on the accelerator for faster sampling.
chat.settings.help.copy_text_attachments: When copying a message containing text attachments, combine them into a single, unformatted text string rather than a special format that would allow them to be pasted back in as attachments
chat.settings.help.custom_json: Custom JSON parameters to send to the API. These must be in a valid JSON format.
chat.settings.help.disable_auto_scroll: Disable automatic scrolling as new messages arrive, allowing you to manually control the viewport position.
chat.settings.help.disable_reasoning_par: Send reasoning_format=none to prevent server-side extraction of reasoning tokens into separate field.
chat.settings.help.dry_allowed_length: Using ‘DRY’ sampling reduces repetition in generated text, even when dealing with lengthy input. This parameter determines the permissible length for ‘DRY’ sampling.
chat.settings.help.dry_base: Using ‘DRY’ sampling reduces repetition in generated text, even when dealing with lengthy input. This parameter sets the base value for ‘DRY’ sampling.
chat.settings.help.dry_multiplier: Using ‘DRY’ sampling reduces repetition in generated text, even when dealing with lengthy input. This parameter controls the ‘DRY’ sampling multiplier.
chat.settings.help.dry_penalty_last_n: Using a ‘DRY’ sampling method reduces repetition in generated text, even when dealing with lengthy input. This parameter sets the repetition penalty applied to the final *n* tokens.
chat.settings.help.dynamic_temperature_e: Add-on for the temperature sampler. Refines the probability redistribution by weighting it towards the most likely token.
chat.settings.help.dynamic_temperature_r: Add-on for the temperature sampler. This enhances the range of dynamic temperatures by adjusting probabilities based on the entropy of the tokens.
chat.settings.help.enable_continue_gener: Enable the “Continue” button for assistant responses. Currently, this feature only functions with models that do not utilise reasoning capabilities.
chat.settings.help.endpoint: Choose Open-ended Responses (recommended) or Chat Completions (legacy)
chat.settings.help.frequency_penalty: Limits the number of tokens based on their frequency in the generated text.
chat.settings.help.keep_stats_visible: Keep the processing statistics displayed once generation is complete.
chat.settings.help.max_tokens: The maximum number of tokens per output. Use -1 to indicate an infinite (unlimited) number.
chat.settings.help.min_p: Limits tokens based on the minimum probability a token must have to be considered, relative to the probability of the most probable token.
chat.settings.help.parse_pdf_as_image: Render PDF as an image rather than text. The system will automatically revert to text-based processing for models that do not utilise image analysis.
chat.settings.help.paste_long_text_to_fi: When a large amount of text is pasted, it will be saved as a file. You can control the file’s size by adjusting the value of this setting. A value of 0 disables this feature.
chat.settings.help.presence_penalty: Limits the number of tokens, depending on whether they are present in the output or not.
chat.settings.help.py_interpreter_enable: Enable the Python interpreter using Pyodide. This allows you to run Python code within markdown code blocks.
chat.settings.help.render_user_content_a: Format user messages in the chat using Markdown.
chat.settings.help.repeat_last_n: The number of previous tokens to take into account when penalising repetition
chat.settings.help.repeat_penalty: Manages the repetition of sequences of tokens within the generated text
chat.settings.help.samplers: The order in which samplers are applied, in a simplified manner. The default is “top_k;typical_p;top_p;minimum_p;temperature”: top_k → typical_p → top_p → minimum_p → temperature
chat.settings.help.show_message_stats: Display generation statistics – such as tokens per second, total token count, and duration – beneath each message from the assistant.
chat.settings.help.show_microphone_on_em: For models that support audio input, automatically display the microphone button instead of the send button when the text input field is empty.
chat.settings.help.show_raw_llm_output: Display the unprocessed output from the large language model, without any backend parsing or frontend Markdown rendering, to enable inspection of the streaming functionality across various models.
chat.settings.help.show_raw_output_switc: Show a per-message toggle to display plain raw model output instead of Markdown rendering.
chat.settings.help.show_system_message: Show the system message at the top of each conversation.
chat.settings.help.show_thought_in_progr: By default, adopt a more comprehensive and considered approach when composing messages.
chat.settings.help.show_tool_calls: Display tool call labels and payloads from any Harmony-compatible `delta.tool_calls` data appearing after the assistant’s messages.
chat.settings.help.system_message: The initial prompt that sets out how the model should operate.
chat.settings.help.temperature: Controls the level of unpredictability in the generated text by influencing the probability distribution of the output tokens. A higher value results in more varied output, while a lower value produces more predictable and focused text.
chat.settings.help.theme: Select the colour scheme for the interface. You can choose between System (which follows your device settings), Light, or Dark.
chat.settings.help.top_p: Limit the tokens to those whose combined probability totals at least p
chat.settings.help.typical_p: Classifies and restricts tokens based on the difference between log-probability and entropy.
chat.settings.help.xtc_probability: The XTC sampler removes the most frequent tokens; this parameter governs the probability of any token being removed. Setting it to 0 disables XTC.
chat.settings.help.xtc_threshold: The XTC sampler omits the most frequent tokens; this parameter governs the token probability threshold required for a token to be omitted.
